snippet.title: RIFT WAR Tower defense trailer
snippet.description:
An eldritch-inspired 2D pixel art tower defense game. Take control of the battlefield and manage limited resources to spawn units and cast spells to defeat your enemy. Destroy the enemy rift portal before they destroy yours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3755300/RIFT_WAR_Tower_defense/ 

"Strength of the Titans" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
